title: Ordinary intrinsic pro-étale direct image: K-injective and bounded-below comparison
statement:
Let $f:X	o Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $B$ be a finite commutative ring, including the zero ring. Fix representatives of the small étale and pro-étale sites small in the universe of module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. On each site use intrinsic sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaf $B_W$ for $W=X,Y$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and their ordinary uncompleted derived categories $D(W_s,B)$, $s\in\{\mathrm{et},\mathrm{proet}\}$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Use the module direct images induced by $f$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-proetale-module-direct-image]. Write $
u_W^*$ for the module comparison inverse image [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], with intrinsic constant-section presentation [lem-pe-coefficient-comparison-data]. Then both module direct images have total right derived functors $Rf_{s,*}$ on the full ordinary derived categories in the sense of [def-sfb-right-derived-functor]. For every K-injective resolution $M	o I$ their values are canonically $Rf_{s,*}M\cong Q(f_{s,*}I)$, where $Q$ is derived localization. On bounded-below objects these functors identify naturally with the usual bounded-below right derived direct images $Rf_{\mathrm{et},*}:D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},B)	o D^+(Y_{\mathrm{et}},B)$ and $Rf_{\mathrm{proet},*}:D^+(X_{\mathrm{proet}},B)	o D^+(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},B)$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]; a bounded-below complex of injectives computes both constructions, and the identifications respect their derived-functor units. The intrinsic constant-section module inverse image and the module inverse image $
u_W^*$ are canonically isomorphic as left adjoints to the same sectionwise module direct image $
u_{W,*}$. Under these identifications, for every $G\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},B)$ there is a natural isomorphism in $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},B)$
$$
u_Y^*Rf_{\mathrm{et},*}G\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_{\mathrm{proet},*}
u_X^*G,$$
which is the bounded-below direct-image comparison isomorphism of [prop-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image] (for $u=f$, $\Lambda=B$, $L=G$) after inclusion into the full derived category. Here $D^+$ means vanishing cohomology in all sufficiently negative degrees [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories], and the derived $
u_W^*$ is termwise inverse image followed by localization [lem-pe-coefficient-comparison-derived-functor]. No claim is made for étale inputs with unbounded-below cohomology.

source.place: Lemma 5.4.3 on bounded-below inputs; ordinary total-derived interpretation using Stacks Tag 070K (derived.tex, lemma-enough-K-injectives-implies) and Tag 070J (derived.tex, lemma-bounded-below-injectives-K-injective); compare Tag 099R (proetale.tex, lemma-morphism-comparison).

proof.text: The intrinsic module categories are Grothendieck abelian by the universe-correct ringed-site construction. The existing Grothendieck K-injective-resolution instance supplies a quasi-isomorphism from every complex into a K-injective complex. Both direct images are additive. Apply additiveDerivedPlus_unit_normalization to obtain the full right-derived normalizations, their units, and computation on bounded-below injective complexes.

Restrict scalars along the constant-ring sheafification units. Restriction is an equivalence: the sheafification adjunction unit is invertible on a fixed-scalar sheaf and the counit is invertible for a locally bijective scalar map. Direct image commutes with restriction by the identity on sections, since the coefficient maps agree on constants. Transport the fixed-scalar comparison adjunction through these equivalences. Its unit on sections is the comparison unit followed by module sheafification; the equivalence triangle and naturality of the comparison unit give the displayed formula. Uniqueness of left adjoints gives the intrinsic pullback identification, and injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence proves uniqueness. The inverse mate of the restriction comparison gives finite-limit preservation; left adjointness gives colimits, hence additivity and exactness.

For etale direct image cancel the scalar-restriction equivalence in its identity-on-sections comparison. For pro-etale direct image use the existing scalar-unit-normalized intrinsic comparison, in the inverse direction. Realization equivalences preserve injectives, so the derived base-change transformations of both coefficient comparisons are invertible by the right-acyclic criterion. Their sections and their actual derived transformations give CoefficientNormalization.

Use the specified qcqs bounded-below comparisonDirectImagePlus. Whisker and compose its isomorphism with the two derived coefficient comparisons and the two realized inverse-image identifications, then cancel the etale realization equivalence on D+. The fully faithful preimage equation proves exactly the required component formula. Whisker this plus comparison with the full-derived inclusion and conjugate by the two unit-normalized plusIso isomorphisms and the exact-pullback inclusion compatibility. Associator and whiskering equations give the displayed fullComparison component formula.
